absent: Numeric values for fanout defaults, level limits, base delays, scaling divisors and callback intervals.
Exact field order, sizes, alignment and padding of node, per processor and shared usage structures.
Encoding of grace and barrier sequences and semantics of helpers that start, sample, compare and test them.
Management of global normal versus expedited flags, nesting counts and scheduler activity states.
Callback list handling, workqueue routing and invocation ordering beyond the scheduling entry points shown.
Full lock ordering involving runqueue, instrumentation and interrupt work interactions.
Tiny configuration index handling, counter storage and grace tracking beyond the fragments shown.
Sizing mode definitions, promotion mechanics to large, and torture mode triggers beyond the predicate shown.
Absolute on disk paths for the routed fragments, only relative sids were provided so paths are AUSENTE.

findings.text: Geometry initialization and online query are externally visible services of the tree component. One prepares level counts and node totals from configured processor count and leaf fanout, while the other reports whether a given processor has ever completed online bringup using an acquire ordered flag.

Non maskable interrupt tolerant SRCU read side primitives expose lock and unlock operations that work on per processor counter sets selected through the shared structure. Lock returns an index identifying the active set for later unlock, and both enforce ordering that keeps the guarded region contained.

Synchronous SRCU grace waiting is available in normal and expedited forms plus a barrier that drains already queued callbacks across processors. Tiny and tree variants share names but apply to different configurations, with the tree form choosing between paths based on idleness hints and global mode.

Lifecycle and diagnostic helpers are exposed for SRCU structures and global grace mode. These include per structure teardown, torture oriented statistics printing, on stack callback head preparation and release, and predicates reporting whether the system favors normal or expedited processing.
Geometry setup runs once and remembers the processor count seen at first entry. A repeat entry only checks that the count is unchanged and otherwise leaves state untouched.

Unspecified force quiescent delays default to a base value plus a per chunk processor allowance, and the scheduler enlistment delay defaults to the first delay plus twice the next delay with a lower bound derived from tick rate and processor count. Explicitly configured values are preserved unchanged.

Leaf fanout must lie within a small lower bound and the width of the node mask word, and the configured processor count must fit within the capacity of the deepest supported tree. Violations restore the compile time leaf value and emit a warning, abandoning recomputation.

Tree shape is derived from capacities that grow geometrically across levels. The level count is the smallest depth whose capacity covers all processors, each level node count is the ceiling of processors divided by the matching capacity, and the total is the sum across levels. Matching compile time values short circuit any adjustment.

An invalid node sequence is recognized by equality with a dedicated initial sentinel. Funnel paths treat that value as never satisfying a needed sequence and therefore continue propagation rather than stopping early.

Expedited need propagation climbs from a starting node toward the root and then to shared root state, stopping when the target sequence is already completed or already covered by a recorded need. Each visited node rechecks under lock before recording the new need.

Normal grace need propagation records per sequence slot callback presence along the leaf to root path, merging the caller processor mask at the leaf. If a node already covers the sequence the climb stops, with special handling that either merges masks on exact match or reschedules local work and returns on mismatch, and expedited requests additionally forward through the expedited path.

A grace period is started only when the shared sequence is idle and not already past the requested value. Starting records the start time, clears the expedited no delay streak, orders the prior need publication before the sequence advance, and is expected to land in the first scanning state.

Callback scheduling is immediate when no delay is requested and otherwise shortens the per processor timer to the requested horizon. The funnel path uses a standard interval for normal requests and no delay for expedited ones when rescheduling.

Barrier processing snapshots the barrier sequence, serializes starters with a mutex, and lets a loser that finds its snapshot already completed return promptly with ordering. Otherwise it starts a new barrier epoch, posts one marker callback per relevant processor while holding a read side guard, then waits on a completion driven by a reference count.

Barrier coverage depends on sizing state. Before the size barrier threshold only the boot processor is targeted, while afterwards every possible processor receives a marker. Entrain failure drops the extra reference that was optimistically taken.

Synchronous waiting is a no operation before the scheduler is active and otherwise blocks on a completion tied to a queued callback. Tree waiting selects expedited handling when the structure appears idle or global expedited mode is set, while the explicit expedited entry degrades to normal when global normal mode is forced.

Automatic expediting is suppressed for slow grace reader flavors, for processors with pending local callbacks, when little time has elapsed since the last grace end relative to a holdoff, when a grace is already needed beyond the current sequence, or when the sequence moves during probing. Only a stable idle observation permits expediting.

Torture statistics report the current grace sequence, sizing state with safe fallback for out of range values, active index derived from the current counter pointer, and per processor outstanding lock minus unlock totals for both counter sets plus callback emptiness and system wide totals. Under torture sizing the reporting also attempts promotion to large mode.
Promotion from small to large mode uses double checked state testing with acquire ordering outside and inside the root lock, returning early unless the state still indicates small.

Teardown requires a nonzero computed delay and absence of active readers, otherwise it warns and intentionally leaks. Tree teardown synchronizes interrupt work before flushing grace work, then per processor deletes timers and flushes worker state, and finally verifies idle grace state plus sequence agreement before freeing nodes and nonstatic per processor and shared storage and resetting to small.

Callback delay starts from a standard interval or zero when expedited, grows by time elapsed since grace start while a grace is active, counts consecutive zero delay phases and forces a minimal delay after a threshold, and is clamped to a maximum interval.
A grace period counts as expedited when the current sequence lags behind the recorded expedited need.
Scale layer operations delegate barrier, synchronous, expedited synchronous and statistics duties to the corresponding SRCU primitives on a shared control structure.

Node tree updates hold the per node spin lock with interrupt state saved across the check and record of needed sequences and callback presence. Root shared state uses a contention aware variant that tries the lock first and records contention on the slow path.

Grace start and delay computation require the shared root lock to be held, asserted by the implementation. Size promotion and the top of tree need publication also serialize on that lock, with need publication using release ordering to precede initialization.

Barrier starters serialize on a dedicated mutex, while per processor marker insertion holds that processor data lock across reference counting and queue entrain. The synchronous wait path pairs its trailing full barrier with the callback invocation lock to order against grace periods the waiter did not otherwise observe.

Idle probing for automatic expediting briefly takes the local processor data lock only to test for pending callbacks, then releases before any lock free global probing. Teardown holds the root lock while sampling delay and flushes work outside locks.

Geometry state consists of scalar leaf fanout, level count and node total plus a per level node count collection indexed by level. Capacities are held in a temporary per level array that grows by the internal fanout at each higher level.

Tree SRCU centers on a shared structure pointing to per processor data and to shared usage state, with nodes linked upward to parents. Usage state carries grace and barrier sequences with needed markers, start time, no delay streak, size state, barrier mutex completion and reference count plus work items, while nodes carry per slot callback sequences, expedited needs and processor presence masks.

Per processor SRCU data carries dual counter sets with separate lock and unlock tallies, a callback list, group mask, leaf node pointer, work and timer items, and a barrier marker head. Read side selection is via a shared current counter pointer dereferenced to the local processor instance.

Scale testing binds a flavor tag, operation callbacks for locking, sequencing, async, barrier, sync, expedited sync and statistics, plus a name, in a single operations record used with a static SRCU instance and paired init and cleanup helpers.

Grace sequences advance through idle to scanning phases and completion, tracked separately for normal needs, expedited needs and barrier epochs. Funnel logic treats done as terminal, idle as eligible to start, and needed values as monotonic requests that only move forward.

Sizing moves from small toward barrier gated and large configurations. Early paths bypass the node tree and target only the boot processor, while post threshold paths traverse the full tree and all possible processors, with promotion guarded to occur once from small.

Barrier epochs snapshot, start, complete and end under mutex protection. An initial reference prevents early completion until all markers are posted, each successful entrain adds a reference released by its callback, and the final decrement wakes the starter.
Geometry initialization is the boot time entry that reconciles compile time fanout and processor limits with runtime configuration and publishes level and node counts for later tree construction.

Blocking SRCU entries accept a shared structure and wait until prior readers drain, with separate entries for normal selection, forced expedited handling, tiny configuration simplicity, and barrier draining of queued work.
Scale lifecycle entries install a static SRCU control block via initialization and release it via cleanup, exposing the instance to the generic scale operations for measurement runs.

Appending boot work without locking is safe only during very early single processor execution with interrupts disabled. After initialization completes the same handoff must use interrupt safe work queuing to avoid runqueue lock inversion.

Teardown intentionally leaks rather than freeing live state when readers remain active, delay computation yields zero, callbacks remain queued, or the grace sequence is not idle and settled. A missing barrier before teardown is a common trigger for the leak path.

Synchronous waiting warns when invoked inside the same flavor SRCU read section or inside core RCU read sections, and tiny teardown warns on any residual running, waiting, queued callback or misaligned index state.

Timer deletion that actually cancels an armed timer while callbacks remain is unexpected for fully online processors and requeues worker handling. Statistics printing tolerates missing per processor storage and out of range sizing values by degrading output rather than faulting.
A maximum unsigned value marks force and scheduler delay parameters as unspecified at boot, triggering calculation of defaults on first geometry setup.
A dedicated initial sequence value denotes invalid or never used node state for callback and expedited need slots.
Named grace states distinguish idle from first scan and sizing states distinguish small from barrier gated progression, with string names backing diagnostic printing.

Compile time fanout values for leaves and internal levels, maximum level count, base force delay, divisor for processor scaling, and standard versus maximum callback intervals bound geometry and timing behavior.
